:::{#ppc}
I am a PhD candidate in Economics at the [University of Cologne](https://uni-koeln.de/en/), a member of [ECONtribute](https://econtribute.de/) and [C-SEB](https://c-seb.de/en/), and an associated member of [DIW Berlin](https://www.diw.de/en).

My main research fields are labor and education economics.

I have visited the Department of Economics at Uppsala University in Spring 2025, hosted by Peter Fredriksson.

Email: santiago-wolf@wiso.uni-koeln.de
:::
